_note: One record per geographic area. 'designations' lists each MARPOL Annex / ECA / PSSA designation with its effective date (MEPC.1/Circ.778/Rev.4). geometry_key refers to geometries.geojson. geometry_status: official_boundary (sea-side boundary from the official coordinate list / boundary lines in MARPOL 2022; landward closure = Natural Earth 1:10m coastline) | derived_approximate | pending_official_coordinates | official (authoritative shapefile).

zones.name: Mediterranean Sea area
zones.boundary_definition: The Mediterranean Sea proper including the gulfs and seas therein, with the boundary between the Mediterranean and the Black Sea constituted by the 41°N parallel and bounded to the west by the Straits of Gibraltar at the meridian of 005°36'W. [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.1 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. Natural Earth 1:50m ocean ∩ envelope bounded by 005°36'W meridian and 41°N parallel (east of 026°48'E). Sea of Marmara falls south of 41°N and is included; Bosphorus falls north of 41°N and is excluded – literal reading, verify.

designations.note: SOx and PM only. Not a NOx Tier III ECA per Circ.778/Rev.4.

zones.name: Baltic Sea area
zones.boundary_definition: The Baltic Sea proper with the Gulf of Bothnia, the Gulf of Finland and the entrance to the Baltic Sea bounded by the parallel of the Skaw in the Skagerrak at 57°44.8'N. [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.2 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope bounded by 57°44.8'N across the Kattegat entrance; Kiel Canal, Limfjord not modelled.

phasing.applies_to: existing passenger ships (other than those below)
existing passenger ships en route directly to/from a port outside the special area and to/from a port east of 028°10'E within the special area, making no other port calls in the special area

designations.phasing_source: MEPC.275(69) as cited in Circ.778/Rev.4 footnote 3

zones.name: Black Sea area
zones.boundary_definition: The Black Sea proper with the boundary between the Mediterranean Sea and the Black Sea constituted by the parallel of 41°N. [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.3 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean north of 41°N between 026°48'E and 042°E. Sea of Azov and the Bosphorus are included by this literal construction – verify treatment.

designations.note: Designated but the Special Area requirements have NOT taken effect (lack of reception-facility notifications, Annex V reg 8.2) – Circ.778/Rev.4 footnote 2. General Annex V requirements apply.

zones.name: Red Sea area
zones.boundary_definition: The Red Sea proper including the Gulfs of Suez and Aqaba bounded at the south by the rhumb line between Ras si Ane (12°28.5'N, 043°19.6'E) and Husn Murad (12°40.4'N, 043°30.2'E). [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.4 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope closed by the Ras si Ane – Husn Murad rhumb line.

zones.name: Gulfs area
zones.boundary_definition: The sea area located north-west of the rhumb line between Ras al Hadd (22°30'N, 059°48'E) and Ras al Fasteh (25°04'N, 061°25'E). [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.5 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope closed by the Ras al Hadd – Ras al Fasteh rhumb line.

zones.name: Gulf of Aden area
zones.boundary_definition: The part of the Gulf of Aden between the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea bounded to the west by the rhumb line between Ras si Ane (12°28.5'N, 043°19.6'E) and Husn Murad (12°40.4'N, 043°30.2'E) and to the east by the rhumb line between Ras Asir (11°50'N, 051°16'.9E) and Ras Fartak (15°35'N, 052°13.8'E). [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.6 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope closed by the two rhumb lines. Gulf of Tadjoura treatment approximate.

zones.name: Antarctic area
zones.boundary_definition: The sea area south of latitude 60°S. [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.7 / Annex V reg 1.14 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean south of 60°S.

zones.name: North West European waters
zones.boundary_definition: The North Sea and its approaches, the Irish Sea and its approaches, the Celtic Sea, the English Channel and its approaches and part of the North East Atlantic immediately to the west of Ireland, bounded by lines joining: 48°27'N on the French coast; 48°27'N, 006°25'W; 49°52'N, 007°44'W; 50°30'N, 012°00'W; 56°30'N, 012°00'W; 62°00'N, 003°00'W; 62°00'N on the Norwegian coast; 57°44.8'N on the Danish and Swedish coasts. [MARPOL Annex I reg 1.11.8 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022, p. 43]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope built from the coordinate list above.

zones.name: Oman area of the Arabian Sea
zones.geometry_note: Official coordinate list (read from the scanned 2022 edition, verified visually) joined by great-circle segments; closed along the Natural Earth 1:10m coastline.

designations.note: Special Area requirements have NOT taken effect (lack of reception-facility notifications, Annex I reg 38.6) – Circ.778/Rev.4 footnote 2.

zones.name: Southern South African waters
zones.geometry_note: Official coordinate list joined by great-circle segments; closed along the Natural Earth 1:10m coastline.

zones.name: North Sea area
zones.boundary_definition: The North Sea proper including seas therein with the boundary between: the North Sea southwards of latitude 62°N and eastwards of longitude 4°W; the Skagerrak, the southern limit of which is determined east of the Skaw by latitude 57°44.8'N; and the English Channel and its approaches eastwards of longitude 5°W and northwards of latitude 48°30'N. [MARPOL Annex V reg 1.14 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope with the 62°N / 4°W / 5°W / 48°30'N / 57°44.8'N limits. Inner Norwegian fjords approximated.

zones.name: Wider Caribbean region including the Gulf of Mexico and the Caribbean Sea
zones.boundary_definition: The Gulf of Mexico and Caribbean Sea proper including the bays and seas therein and that portion of the Atlantic Ocean within the boundary constituted by the 30°N parallel from Florida eastward to the 077°30'W meridian, thence a rhumb line to the intersection of 20°N and 059°W, thence a rhumb line to the intersection of 07°20'N and 050°W, thence a rhumb line drawn south-westerly to the eastern boundary of French Guiana. [MARPOL Annex V reg 1.14 – verified against MARPOL Consolidated Edition 2022]
zones.geometry_note: Sea-side boundary from the regulation; landward closure Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. ocean ∩ envelope from the limits above.

zones.name: North American Emission Control Area
zones.boundary_definition: Three sea areas enclosed by geodesic lines connecting the coordinates in MARPOL Annex VI Appendix VII para 2 (2022 edition pp. 333-340): Pacific coasts of the US and Canada (47 points), Atlantic coasts of the US, Canada and France (Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon) and the Gulf of Mexico coast of the US (206 points), Hawaiian Islands (45 points). Full list in data/eca_coordinates.txt.
zones.geometry_note: 298 official points (MEPC.190(60) text layer, corrected row-by-row against the 2022 consolidated edition, e.g. Atlantic pt 158) joined by great-circle segments; Pacific and Atlantic/Gulf areas closed along the Natural Earth 1:10m coastline. Great Lakes excluded by the ocean mask.

zones.name: United States Caribbean Sea Emission Control Area
zones.boundary_definition: Sea area off the Atlantic and Caribbean coasts of Puerto Rico and the US Virgin Islands enclosed by geodesic lines connecting the 55 coordinates in MARPOL Annex VI Appendix VII para 3 (2022 edition pp. 340-341). Full list in data/eca_coordinates.txt.
zones.geometry_note: 55 official points (MEPC.202(62) text layer, corrected against the 2022 edition for points 28-30) joined by great-circle segments; closed ring.
